introduction: Legal Aid of Nebraska screens civil legal-help requests through AccessLine or its online callback application. Use the specialized line when an older adult, disaster or other listed program fits.
description: Legal Aid of Nebraska screens civil legal-help requests through AccessLine or its online callback application. Use the specialized line when an older adult, disaster or other

sections.who: The organization reviews household income, assets, the issue and eligibility for its projects. It does not handle ordinary criminal defense or every kind of civil dispute.
sections.get: Accepted applicants may receive civil legal assistance. Intake must confirm the scope; submitting a form does not mean a lawyer has agreed to handle a court case.
sections.docs:
• Keep notices, contracts and court papers ready.
  • Prepare a short timeline and identify the next deadline.
  • Have household income and asset details available.
sections.apply:
1. Choose intake

    Call AccessLine at 1-877-250-2016 or use the online callback portal linked from Call for Help.

  2. Check the schedule

    AccessLine publishes different morning and afternoon windows by weekday. Confirm the current hours before calling.

  3. Explain urgent papers

    Tell intake about a response deadline or hearing and ask what help, if any, has been accepted.
sections.after: Record advice and next steps. If the organization cannot assist, ask about another resource and continue tracking deadlines.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Legal Aid of Nebraska intake and eligibility. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is there a line for older Nebraskans?
ElderAccessLine serves people aged 60 or older; the current contact page lists 1-800-527-7249.
Can I request a callback online?
Yes. The Call for Help page links the online intake portal.
Does Legal Aid handle every case?
No. The organization screens eligibility and lists excluded case types on its contact page.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
